'''Code Grave''' was an alert level utilized by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Any mission given the alert level was made mandatory.

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] had to [[Mission to Tatooine (Luke Skywalker)|return]] to his [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] under the orders of the Rebel Alliance via [[Massassi One]] via this alert level, although to Skywalker's reluctance.
